races.race_name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sweet Iris
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at Carlisle (7f, good) a fortnight ago and could do with settling better but this easier track is a likely positive and she was a promising second at York (7f, good to firm) last month; she's one to consider.
runners.comment: Well beaten at Carlisle but promising second at York before that and she's one to consider

runners.name: Inns And Out
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming on last two starts, most recently his nursery debut at Thirsk (6f, good to firm); however, before those he was third at Ripon (6f, good) in June on his second outing and he's in the mix on that form.
runners.comment: Underwhelming on last two starts but he's in the mix on his previous form

runners.name: Wild Orchid
runners.spotlight: She needs to improve upon what she's shown on her two starts (6f/7f, good to firm/AW) but she attracted market support at Lingfield last time and is the type to progress with racing; her trainer has won two of the last three runnings and she could be involved.
runners.comment: Improvement needed on third start but trainer has won two of the last three runnings

runners.name: Gordons Girl
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam ran twice 5f/6f 2yo (RPR 64), from a talented family featuring some speedy sorts; this Cracksman newcomer may be one for later on but market support would bring her into the equation.
runners.comment: First foal; dam ran twice 2yo (RPR 64), from a talented family featuring some speedy sorts

runners.name: Vegasmile
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros foal, 45,000euros yearling; eighth foal; Lucky Vega half-brother to winners Fleetfoot (1m-2m, RPR 109), Mashaaer (Listed-placed 1m AW; 99) and Elsaabiqaat (5f 2yo; 78); dam 7f winner (including 2yo; 98); with a top yard and makes debut in a modest race; firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: With a top yard and makes debut in a modest race; firmly in calculations
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd LIII & E Burke

runners.name: Pigeon Pete
runners.spotlight: 10,000gns yearling; second foal; dam 1m2f winner (RPR 86) out of German 1m Listed winner; this Cracksman newcomer is one to watch in the betting for his good stable, but it's not a yard known for success with 2yos.
runners.comment: Debut; one to watch in betting for good stable but it's not a yard known for 2yo success

runners.name: Coul Blue
runners.spotlight: 13-2 for last month's debut over C&D (good) but was soundly beaten, as was the case when 33-1 at Ayr (6f, good) subsequently.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on both starts and substantial improvement is necessary
runners.owner: Mrs T Burns And Rjh Ltd

runners.name: Basmaah
runners.spotlight: The step up in trip could be a positive on this second start but she couldn't get into it when 80-1 for her recent debut at Thirsk (5f, good) and others have far more substance to their claims.
runners.comment: Couldn't get into it when 80-1 for her recent debut at Thirsk (5f, good); goes up in trip

runners.name: Diplomacy
runners.spotlight: Down the field this summer on his two starts (7f/7.4f, good to firm), at 40-1 then 80-1, and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Down the field this summer on his two starts, at 40-1 then 80-1, and others are preferred

runners.name: Threeoclockflyer
runners.spotlight: 100-1 when always in rear on last month's debut at Ayr (7f, good); highly likely that he remains best watched for now.
runners.comment: 100-1 when always in rear on last month's debut at Ayr (7f, good)

runners.name: Spectacular Diver
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who was gelded prior to a resurgent effort at Beverley (5f) last time; again has place possibilities, assuming he starts to show some consistency.
runners.comment: Gelded prior to resurgent effort at Beverley last time; again has place possibilities

runners.name: Mardy Bum
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; ran creditably at Catterick on handicap debut but her form has dipped markedly since; doesn't look as if she's about to get off the mark.
runners.comment: Ran respectably on handicap debut but her form has dipped markedly since

runners.name: Lauralynn
runners.spotlight: Has a record of 1-1 on AW compared to 0-4 on turf but is proving consistent; creditable third at Carlisle on return from layoff last time; reasonably solid contender.
runners.comment: Gained sole win on AW but is proving consistent; reasonably solid contender
runners.owner: Ger O'Neill & Unique Retreats Stays Ltd

runners.name: Needin' U
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who posted best effort when fourth in C&D seller that has thrown up a few winners since; interesting returned to this scenario on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Posted best effort when fourth in C&D seller that has thrown up a few winners since

runners.name: Aodhan
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced gelding who appeared to posted an improved effort when the rank outsider in C&D maiden most recently; may back up the form kept to same scenario.
runners.comment: Appeared to post an improved effort when the rank outsider in C&D maiden last time

runners.name: Savoy Blue
runners.spotlight: Brings the worst form having failed to beat a rival in maidens, recording RPRs in the 20s; best watched unless the market suggests improvement is on the cards.
runners.comment: Brings the worst form having failed to beat a rival in maidens

runners.name: Bea Kindly
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who is far from solid on form and failed to beat a rival in 6f nursery most recently; chance largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Chance largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear

runners.name: Stay On Tab
runners.spotlight: Not particularly solid on spring form but may do better now handicapping in first-time headgear on return from break; check the betting for further guidance.
runners.comment: May do better now handicapping in first-time headgear on return from break

runners.name: Amber Hamur
runners.spotlight: Made all at Hamilton (8.3f, good) on second stable start and followed up at Ripon (1m, good) with something to spare; there can be optimism that this easy 1m1f will be within range and that latest 5lb rise will not stop her.
runners.comment: Has done very well for new yard and won her last 2; latest 5lb rise may well not stop her

runners.name: Balmoral Boy
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but ran his best race yet when runner-up at Ripon (1m2f, good to firm) four weeks ago, when going beyond 1m for the first time; his trainer won this last year and he could be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: Best run yet when second at Ripon last time and his trainer won this last year

runners.name: Dalamara
runners.spotlight: Kept on for a respectable fourth of eight at Redcar (1m, good to firm) recently when back from a 51-day break; she's dropped back down to her winning mark and might not be far away in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Respectable fourth at Redcar after a break and she's dropped back down to her winning mark

runners.name: Only Dream Big
runners.spotlight: Two quick wins in June (7f/1m, good; including here) and she returned to form with a close third at Carlisle (7f, good) a fortnight ago; there is every chance that she'll stay 1m1f and she could be bang there.
runners.comment: 1m course winner who was a close third at Carlisle recently; could be bang there

runners.name: Trucial Pearl
runners.spotlight: Ran some good races in the spring prior to getting off the mark at the 12th attempt at Ripon (1m, good) in June and close fourth of 13 in Thirsk classified (1m, good to firm) since, when caught wide; in with a chance.
runners.comment: She's been in good form this summer and is in with a chance

runners.name: Vitality
runners.spotlight: She made a promising start to her career in April but has become disappointing and needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: She made a promising start to her career in April but has become disappointing
runners.owner: Miss D Finkler, A Herd, Dr P Holloway 1

runners.name: Positive Thoughts
runners.spotlight: Ran well when third of six to Amber Hamur at Hamilton (8.3f, good) last month but two lesser performances have followed and she's now 0-9.
runners.comment: Third at Hamilton last month but two lesser runs have followed and she's now 0-9

runners.name: Horwich
runners.spotlight: He's dropped considerably in the weights but hasn't been shaping of late as though he's about to take advantage; badly hampered and unseated after two furlongs at Ripon ten days ago.
runners.comment: Has dropped considerably in the weights but not shaping as though he's about to capitalise

runners.name: Cascade Hall
runners.spotlight: Easily made all here (2m, good) in June and he's run well in third on his last two starts, most recently behind Inappropriate here (2m, good); could give it a good go from the front but this is warmer than he's used to.
runners.comment: Course winner who arrives in good heart but this is warmer than he's used to

runners.name: Gallus Norman
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 7yo who won here (2m, good) in May and at Ayr (1m7f, soft) in June; returned to form with good third at Hamilton (1m5f, good) last time and he's a possible contender.
runners.comment: Very lightly raced 7yo who has won twice this year and was a good third last time

runners.name: Is She Now
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-6 since joining Daragh Bourke when winning at Doncaster (14.5f, good to firm) ten days ago, when she idled in front and was value for more than the 0.75l winning margin; went close over 16.2f at Newcastle previously; she might still be ahead of the handicapper up 3lb for last time; a first-time visor replaces cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Made it 3-6 for yard with Doncaster win and she might still be ahead of the handicapper

runners.name: Ned Broy
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who won when upped in trip at Newcastle (16.2f, AW) last month and there can be optimism that he's fine on grass, having kept on well for second at Hamilton (1m3f, good) in May; unexposed over staying distances and could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Won over 16.2f at Newcastle last month and he's unexposed over staying distances

runners.name: Inappropriate
runners.spotlight: Short-headed when upped in trip at Ayr (2m, good) last month on his second stable start before winning here (2m, good); he's just 1lb higher than last time and could have more to offer over staying distances; respected.
runners.comment: Won when upped to 2m here last month and could have more to offer over staying trips

runners.name: Vaguely Royal
runners.spotlight: Exploited a reduced mark to win at Chester (1m6f, good) last month and he followed up at York (2m, good to firm), both in this visor in which he's unexposed; remains well treated on his old form and he's a key player.
runners.comment: Has won his last two and he remains well treated on his old form; key player

runners.name: Newport
runners.spotlight: He's won here over hurdles and he broke his Flat duck at Redcar (1m6f, good to firm) recently; he's just 3lb higher today and the longer trip may suit; could be in the mix.
runners.comment: He's won here over hurdles and he broke his Flat duck at Redcar recently; in the mix

runners.name: Fast Fred
runners.spotlight: Won here (1m4f, good) in April; beaten a head at Chester (1m4f, good) last month and again finished second at Haydock (1m6f, good) last time; ran well over an extended 2m at York last season and could be involved.
runners.comment: Course winner who has been runner-up on his last two starts and could be involved

runners.name: Trojan Sun
runners.spotlight: Won this in 2024 and posted his first win of this year at Carlisle (1m6f, good) in June; soundly beaten on his last two starts but this four-time course winner could bounce back returned to Musselburgh.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on last two starts but this four-time course winner could revive back here

runners.name: Furhaan
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at York (16.2f, good to firm) last month and good third to Vaguely Royal there (16.2f, good to firm) last time; this in-form 4yo has an each-way shout once more.
runners.comment: Placed at York on his last two starts and he has an each-way shout once more

runners.name: Florida Dreams
runners.spotlight: Won a Grade 2 bumper in 2023 and he's a useful hurdler; some respectable efforts switched to the Flat this year (1m3f/1m1f) and he could take a sizeable step forward now up in trip on his Flat handicap debut; certainly has potential off his opening mark in view of his hurdling ability.
runners.comment: Up in trip for Flat h'cap debut; has potential off this mark in view of hurdling ability

races.race_name: AAB Group And Bibby Financial Services Handicap

runners.name: Coconut Bay
runners.spotlight: Losing run is mounting up; however, well treated on best form and last few efforts (432) suggest her turn may be near; runner-up at Thirsk (7f) latest; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Well treated on best form and last few efforts suggest her turn may be near

runners.name: Monhammer
runners.spotlight: Successful four times over C&D, including in last two starts, beating stablemate Keep Me Stable by 1l latest; this 8yo retains plenty of vitality and is still well handicapped on historical data; beaten in this race for last three years (form figures 002) but warrants respect in current form.
runners.comment: Successful four times over C&D, including in last two starts; retains plenty of vitality

runners.name: Luminous Warrior
runners.spotlight: Bids for hat-trick after completing a Yarmouth double (1m/6f) for Dylan Cunha; shade fortuitous last time (runner-up's rider dropped whip) and switches to a contrasting venue on debut for new yard.
runners.comment: Shade fortuitous last time when completing a Yarmouth double; debut for new yard

runners.name: Novak
runners.spotlight: Gained last five wins on AW but has proved consistent in Scotland since returned to turf; finished 1l second at Ayr (7f) most recently; reasonably solid contender in current form.
runners.comment: Consistent in Scotland since returned to turf; finished 1l second at Ayr last time

runners.name: Sir David
runners.spotlight: Gamely prevailed by a neck at Beverley (7.5f, good to firm) last time, doubling his tally; back up 3lb but remains well treated on peak form; looks likely to remain competitive.
runners.comment: Gamely prevailed at Beverley last time; remains well treated on peak form

runners.name: Edmond Halley
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who has raced mainly at shorter; encouraging form for new stable and the way he shaped at Catterick last time, when a clear third, suggests this return to 7f is worth exploring; one to consider.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish maiden; encouraging form for new stable; return to 7f is worth exploring

runners.name: Vince Le Prince
runners.spotlight: Placed several times this term, including in higher grade at Catterick last week; continues on a long losing run but remains 8lb below last winning mark; again in the mix.
runners.comment: Placed several times this term, including latest start; still 8lb below last winning mark

runners.name: Keep Me Stable
runners.spotlight: Completed a Musselburgh hat-trick last summer; back in form this month, finishing 1l second to stablemate Monhammer over C&D then third at Ayr where she hung right; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Suited by Musselburgh; ties in with stablemate Monhammer on penultimate effort

runners.name: Joshuas Dream
runners.spotlight: Went close in one of his maiden attempts but has unconvincing form in handicaps, the latest at Musselburgh on Monday; something to prove.
runners.comment: Maiden who has unconvincing handicap form; ninth of 13 here on Monday

runners.name: Gressington
runners.spotlight: Has dropped to Class 6 the last twice, showing signs of a revival at Ayr then never figuring at Catterick; current mark reflects a broad decline in his form this year.
runners.comment: Never figured last time, failing to back up penultimate effort
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Evangelic
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has shown poor form (Flat/hurdles) for current stable; fitting of tongue-tie and cheekpieces needs to make a big difference back under this code.
runners.comment: Maiden; poor form (Flat/hurdles) for current stable; tongue-tie and cheekpieces fitted

runners.name: Albegone
runners.spotlight: 8yo who is 0-14 this season, with mixed form, but there have been bright points and he's dropped to a dangerous mark; this two-time C&D winner is not discounted.
runners.comment: 0-14 this season but this two-time C&D winner has dropped to a dangerous mark
runners.owner: D B & Mrs C Lamplough & Partner

runners.name: Beerwah
runners.spotlight: He's been up and down this season but has won twice (5f, good to firm) and was a good second at Bath (5.7f, good to firm) last time when denied a clear run; no surprise if this progressive 4yo makes amends today.
runners.comment: Two wins this season and denied a clear run when second at Bath last time

runners.name: Jojo Rabbit
runners.spotlight: Made all at Pontefract in April and runner-up twice in a row in May; not written off but subsequent form has been mixed so he's not a solid option.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice in a row in May but his subsequent form has been mixed
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing XIII & Ruth Carr

runners.name: Zuffolo
runners.spotlight: Back on song when third at Catterick (5f, good to firm) last month and he built on that to win at Ripon (5f, good to firm); he's gone up just 2lb for last time and could be a contender once more.
runners.comment: He's gone up just 2lb for his win at Ripon last time and could be a contender once more
runners.owner: R R D Saunders And Partner

runners.name: South Parade
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who has returned to form on her last two starts, finishing third over C&D (good) then winning at Ayr (5f, good); remains well treated on her old form and she's respected.
runners.comment: C&D winner who scored at Ayr recently and remains well treated on her old form
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Pouting
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on stable debut last August and same story at Catterick in June on sole run this season; plenty to prove but she's dropped down the weights and her trainer is in fine form; one to watch in the betting.
runners.comment: Plenty to prove but her trainer is in fine form and she's one to watch in the betting

races.race_name: Smarter Gambling Starts At gambling.com Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Thapa Vc
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f course winner; 7f wins at Doncaster and Yarmouth last month, the latter off 7lb lower, but he wasn't suited by a modestly run race at the former track ten days ago; left the impression he's still in form and he holds claims returned to 1m.
runners.comment: Dual winner last month; wasn't suited by a modest gallop at Doncaster last time; claims

runners.name: Great Blasket
runners.spotlight: Visored for the first time when making a winning stable debut at Nottingham (8.5f, good to firm) last month and, although a beaten short-price favourite, posted another solid effort under a penalty at Sandown (1m); now 2lb higher but remains fairly treated on older form.
runners.comment: Won in a first-time visor on his stable debut before a solid third at Sandown last time

runners.name: Ernie's Valentine
runners.spotlight: Seven of his eight wins have been on the AW, the most recent coming at Wolverhampton (8.5f) last November off a 3lb higher mark; shaped as if in form when seventh of 12 there in a 0-80 in March but he's been absent since; considered.
runners.comment: Seven-time AW winner; 3lb below his last winning mark but absent since March; considered.

runners.name: Dannick
runners.spotlight: Course winner over 7f three starts back off 9lb lower; went close at Southwell (7f, AW) when ridden by Jude Fernandes next time but blew his chance by hanging right over this C&D three days ago; visor is removed and he needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Course winner; went close at Southwell but blew his chance by hanging right on Saturday

runners.name: Havana Touch
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been on the AW, the last three at Kempton, most recently over 1m in June when last seen off a 4lb lower mark; went close here over 7f in April and can be competitive on his return from a 76-day break.
runners.comment: Four-time AW winner; off since winning at Kempton 76 days ago and now 4lb higher

runners.name: Majestic Wave
runners.spotlight: 1-19; has tumbled in the weights since joining this stable from Ireland and ran a solid race when runner-up behind Dannick here over 7f last time; latest effort can be forgiven (raced wide) but he isn't certain to appreciate the step back up in trip.
runners.comment: Latest effort came be forgiven, as he raced wide, but the return to 1m is a concern

runners.name: Amused
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 15 starts came at Vichy (7f, very soft) when trained in France; has returned to form since having the headgear removed, finishing runner-up at Sandown (1m, good to firm) on two occasions, including when narrowly ahead of Great Blasket last time; makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: 1-15; runner-up at Sandown on his last two starts since headgear was removed; shortlisted
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Renesmee
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner; ran well when second of 15 at Chester (1m4f, good) in May but she's been below her best in the four starts since; on a workable mark but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Triple AW winner but below her best since finishing runner-up at Chester in May

runners.name: Nezeeh
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner on turf but 0-12 on the AW; has struggled since winning at Bellewstown (5f, soft) last October and well beaten in his two starts since joining this stable; back up to 1m; best watched.
runners.comment: 0-12 on AW and well beaten in his two starts for this stable; back up to 1m; best watched

races.race_name: Advice You Can Trust At Gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Lazurite
runners.spotlight: Flopped at Goodwood when last seen, having boiled over in the preliminaries; solid second, in front of two subsequent Listed scorers, at Newmarket earlier in May and sets a strong standard on that debut form; steps up to 6f.
runners.comment: Both starts in May; sets a strong standard on debut form, namely second at Newmarket

runners.name: Dark Reign
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred but has recorded meagre RPRs in her two races, beaten about 12l both times; likely to be more interesting in handicaps shortly; drops a bit further in distance.
runners.comment: Has recorded meagre RPRs; likely to be more interesting in nurseries
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Cotai Jaunt
runners.spotlight: 40,000euros yearling, £15,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; Cotai Glory half-sister to five winners, notably Royal Pleasure (6f-1m2f AW including 2yo; RPR 101); dam 1m2f AW winner (70), half-sister to 1m2f Grade 1 winner Seek Again; suitably bred debutante.
runners.comment: £15,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; bred to take well to AW; interesting debutante

runners.name: Cuban Promise
runners.spotlight: £62,000 yearling; by Havana Grey and first foal of Italian 5f-6f scorer (including 2yo) who is half-sister to Italian 1m1f 2yo Group 3 winner Isfahani; heed the market signals.
runners.comment: £62,000 yearling; by Havana Grey; heed the market signals
runners.owner: Moulton Racing And Whitsbury Manor Stud

runners.name: Lady Of Lucca
runners.spotlight: 25,000gns foal; by Minzaal; dam maiden (RPR 61), closely related to 5f 2yo winner On The Stage and half-sister to 6f Group 3 scorer Projection; stable is only 1-41 with 2yos.
runners.comment: 25,000gns foal; by Minzaal; stable is only 1-41 with 2yos

runners.name: Thai Baht
runners.spotlight: Sister to 6f 2yo winner Rising Empire (RPR 88); dam 5f 2yo winner (82), out of maiden half-sister to useful 1m winner Starbright, from family US 1m1f Grade 1 winner Tuscan Evening; likely sort on breeding.
runners.comment: Sister to a 6f 2yo winner; likely type on breeding

runners.name: Ambience
runners.spotlight: Had wind surgery since failing to live up to expectations (finished only sixth of seven) in 6f event at Newmarket in May; the type who should be capable of much better, being a Frankel filly who cost 850,000gns as a foal.
runners.comment: Had wind surgery since failing to live up to expectations at Newmarket in May

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes

runners.name: Jungle Dance
runners.spotlight: Won twice on the AW in February 2024, including over C&D; without a win since but he ran well when runner-up behind Let's Go Hugo at Wolverhampton on first start for 177 days; may come on for that and he could go well.
runners.comment: Won twice in February 2024 but winless since; ran well when runner-up to Let's Go Hugo

runners.name: Banana
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; won twice on turf last year; ran well on reappearance at Chepstow (5f) and another solid effort when fourth behind three 3yos at Yarmouth last time; 0-44 on the AW but she has finished runner-up five times.
runners.comment: Fourth behind three 3yos at Yarmouth last time; runner-up on the AW five times

runners.name: Let's Go Hugo
runners.spotlight: Had cheekpieces reapplied when gaining his fourth success on the AW in a classified event at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) eight days ago, winning by 2l; has strong claims in his bid to follow up.
runners.comment: Had cheekpieces back on when winning a similar event at Wolverhampton; has strong claims

runners.name: Bust A Moon
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 23 starts came in a Beverley seller last May when trained by David Evans; made some late gains at Redcar last time but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: 1-23; made some late gains at Redcar latest but others have stronger claims

runners.name: Viennetta
runners.spotlight: Hooded all four starts; well held in two for Jamie Osborne and it's been the same story in both for this stable, including on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (6f) last month; drops into a classified but she's best watched.
runners.comment: Well held in each of her four starts and now drops into a classified; best watched

runners.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has failed to beat a rival in three of her last four starts; headgear is discarded.
runners.comment: 0-8; has failed to beat a rival in three of her last four starts; headgear removed

runners.name: Apple's Angel
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last June but she's been unplaced in all five starts since joining this stable; didn't see it out over 7f at Brighton last time but should appreciate this drop back in trip; hood is removed and she has each-way chance.
runners.comment: C&D winner last June; didn't stay 7f at Brighton last time; hood removed; each-way claims
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Bluesy Moon
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden who was beaten 12l here over 6f in April on her first start for 196 days; off again since and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: 0-17; beaten 12l here over 6f in April and has been off again since; best watched

runners.name: Battle Point
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 54 starts came over this C&D in April 2023; wasn't helped by racing wide when fourth behind Let's Go Hugo at Wolverhampton eight days ago and makes some each-way appeal.
runners.comment: One win from 54 starts; raced wide when fourth behind Let's Go Hugo eight days ago

runners.name: Lochaber
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 26 starts came in a seller at Beverley in May 2024; mostly disappointing since and he's been absent since finishing fourth at Bath last June; best watched on his reappearance.
runners.comment: Mostly disappointing since his sole success and he's been absent since last June

runners.name: Quick Quasar
runners.spotlight: Went close in first-time cheekpieces on his handicap debut at Southwell in March and went one better at Kempton (7f, AW) next time; best effort since when fourth at Wolverhampton (7f; first-time blinkers) two starts back but failed to build on that over this C&D 12 days ago.
runners.comment: Kempton winner in March; failed to build on his Wolverhampton run here last time

runners.name: Viking Glory
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when winning at Brighton (7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) 20 days ago, coming from off the pace; he's unexposed over 7f and still looks fairly treated off this 5lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Off the mark in first-time cheekpieces at Brighton; fairly treated off a 5lb higher mark

runners.name: Bird Of War
runners.spotlight: Below par at Ffos Las three weeks ago but his best efforts have been on the AW, including when a close-up third of 13 at Newcastle (7f, AW) in June; he's a contender back on this surface.
runners.comment: Best efforts have been on the AW so may bounce back from a lesser effort on turf

runners.name: Musical Soldier
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally when winning in first-time cheekpieces at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last month and followed up with a narrow success here on turf 24 days ago; a 1lb rise may not be enough to prevent another bold bid.
runners.comment: Followed up his Wolverhampton win with a narrow success here on turf; now only 1lb higher

runners.name: Athena's War
runners.spotlight: 0-4 for Andrew Balding and she was well held when eighth of 14 on her stable/handicap debut at Kempton (1m, AW) two weeks ago; may come on for that first start since March but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Well held on her stable/handicap debut over 1m at Kempton two weeks ago; others stronger

runners.name: Coxy's Star
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward from her previous two efforts when fourth of 12 in a Southwell novice (7f, AW) last month but she disappointed on her handicap debut at Kempton (1m, AW) two weeks ago; dropping back in trip may help.
runners.comment: Fourth in a Southwell novice last month but disappointing on his handicap debut over 1m

runners.name: Ragaire
runners.spotlight: Struggled in four starts for Joseph O'Brien (5f-7f) and it was the same story on his stable/handicap debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; best watched.
runners.comment: Struggled in four starts in Ireland and on his stable debut at  Windsor 12 days ago

runners.name: Strong Voice
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden but he did run well when runner-up at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) in June and didn't shape badly at Kempton (7f, AW; first-time cheekpieces and tongue-tie) six days ago; down in grade; considered.
runners.comment: 0-6; runner-up in June and didn't shape badly when sixth at Kempton latest; down in grade

runners.name: Tie Fighter
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden whose best effort came when narrowly denied in a novice at Leicester (5f, good to soft) last October; well beaten over 6f on his final start for Ed Dunlop and now steps back up in trip on his stable debut having been bought for 8,000gns; watch the betting.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden; well beaten on his final start for Ed Dunlop; back up to 7f on yard debut

races.race_name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Dialstone
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) in June and filled the same position when odds-on at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) three weeks ago, albeit 21l behind a very exciting Godolphin newcomer; leading claims today.
runners.comment: Runner-up on both starts (including on Polytrack) and he has leading claims today
runners.owner: A D G Oldrey & G C Hartigan

runners.name: Devil's Brigade
runners.spotlight: Three-race maiden who has been absent since last November but he kept on for second of 14 at Chelmsford (1m, Polytrack) when last seen and will be a key player if reappearing in similarly good form.
runners.comment: Absent since last November but runner-up when last seen and he's a key player on that form

runners.name: Floating Market
runners.spotlight: Kept on for respectable fifth of nine at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) in March, when last seen, and her attractive pedigree firmly indicates she'll be suited by the step up in trip on her return to action; one to consider.
runners.comment: Showed ability over 1m in the spring and today's extra yardage could be a firm positive

runners.name: State Express
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward when fifth of six at 66-1 at Wolverhampton (9.4f, Tapeta) last Tuesday on his second start but didn't show enough to suggest he would be a serious contender today.
runners.comment: Took a step forward last week but didn't show enough to be a serious contender today

runners.name: Sax Avoidance
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on her two starts (1m2f, good to firm), at 40-1 and 150-1, and she again looks up against it.
runners.comment: Well beaten on her two starts, at 40-1 and 150-1, and she again looks up against it

runners.name: Anncanya
runners.spotlight: Reportedly lost her action in the dip and was unsuited by the fast ground when well beaten on last month's debut at Newmarket (1m, good to firm); she was sent off at just 9-2 and her dam was useful for connections; one to watch in the betting on this second outing.
runners.comment: Had excuses when well beaten at 9-2 on last month's debut; one to watch in the betting

runners.name: Echo That
runners.spotlight: Big prices for both 2yo starts (7f/1m, Polytrack) and she failed to beat a rival; transformation needed in first-time cheekpieces on reappearance.
runners.comment: Big prices for both 2yo starts and she failed to beat a rival; makes reappearance

runners.name: Going To Graceland
runners.spotlight: Reared at the start and tailed off on debut here (1m, Polytrack) last December; absent since but he was sent off at just 11-2 for that sole run and it will be interesting to see how he goes in the betting.
runners.comment: Reared start/tailed off last winter on sole run; interesting to see how he goes in market

runners.name: Hove Ranger
runners.spotlight: Prevailed by a neck in C&D contest last week on return to this sphere, taking record in AW handicaps to 211; incurs 6lb penalty but Toby Moore takes off 7lb; open to further progress; respected.
runners.comment: Prevailed in C&D contest last week, taking record in AW handicaps to 211; respected

runners.name: Sovereign Bright
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden (0-12) but has a stronger record on AW than on turf and is 12lb lower than last appearance in this sphere; possibilities, assuming the plausible resurgence materialises.
runners.comment: Still a maiden but has a stronger record on AW than on turf

runners.name: Havana Tobouggaloo
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden who is well treated on peak turf effort, namely second off 2lb higher at Bath in April; still rather an unknown quantity on AW, having raced only once in this sphere.
runners.comment: Maiden who is well treated on peak turf effort; second attempt on AW

runners.name: Jimmy Mark
runners.spotlight: Raced mainly on turf, winning five times off lower marks; best efforts this term when runner-up twice at Bath; chance back on AW partly depends on the effects of first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Chance back on AW partly depends on the effects of first-time tongue-tie

runners.name: Backer Bilk
runners.spotlight: Has shown better form over hurdles than on the Flat in 2026 but may benefit from the return from this scenario, having gained sole success over C&D; second start for new yard.
runners.comment: May benefit from the return to this scenario, having gained sole win over C&D

runners.name: Thunder Goddess
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who is from a family that has served her connections well; showed some promise at Windsor (1m) most recently; open to improvement in handicaps and should be suited by this new trip; interesting.
runners.comment: Open to improvement in handicaps and should be suited by the new trip; interesting

runners.name: Time To Sparkle
runners.spotlight: Scored narrowly at Wolverhampton in last AW attempt; has remained in form on turf since, creditable third at Windsor (1m2f) most recently; Harry Vigors takes off a useful 5lb; solid chance returned to this sphere.
runners.comment: Won her last AW attempt; has remained in form on turf since; solid claims

runners.name: Minerality
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who is far from solid on form; finished last of seven in Epsom handicap most recently; chance largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Chance largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden

runners.name: Karrygrant
runners.spotlight: Has finished in the frame in seven of his eight starts up to 1m2.5f in varying ground conditions; the form of his Curragh third over this trip has been advertised by the winner since; should be suited by this track but his wide draw is a negative.
runners.comment: Curragh third over this trip is strong form; this track should suit but draw is a negative

runners.name: Star Of Beauty
runners.spotlight: Placed four times from nine starts up to this trip; didn't get the clearest of runs at Gowran last time but is better judged on some of her better previous efforts; can lead so has a good draw to go forward; big player.
runners.comment: Placed four times; is better than her run last time; has a good draw to go forward; player
runners.owner: David K Kelly & Mrs Pauline Condon

runners.name: Camino Lad
runners.spotlight: Was a close second at Ballinrobe over 1m1.5f in June but was disappointing over 2f further at Killarney since; blinkers are added for the drop back to this trip so has to be considered.
runners.comment: Below form over 1m3.5f last time; blinkers on for the drop back in trip so  considered

runners.name: Mosel
runners.spotlight: Beaten 11l on debut in a Curragh maiden over 1m1f; should have improved from that and trainer/rider combination is flying so has to be considered; yard selected of two.
runners.comment: Should have improved from debut and trainer/rider combination is flying so considered

runners.name: Tax Me Later
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; dam French 11.5f winner, sister to 1m1f Listed winner Pilote, closely related to Listed-placed 6.5f/7f winner Femina, half-sister to winners Damysus (1m1f Group 3); Eur24,000 yearling is by a decent young sire and comes from a respected yard; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Eur24,000 yearling is by a decent young sire; from a respected yard; worth a market check

runners.name: Sweetie Too
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way on Gowran debut but produced a much better effort at Naas since; could get more closely involved with further improvement.
runners.comment: Better effort at Naas last time; could get more closely involved with further improvement

runners.name: Willofthepeople
runners.spotlight: The best of three runs last year came over 5f on debut; off a long time and tongue-tie is added to cheekpieces; has to find improvement on return and looks the stable second-string.
runners.comment: Didn't progress as 2yo; market could guide on return but has to find improvement anyway

runners.name: Caption This
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam 5f-1m winner (inc 2yo; RPR 96), sister to 1m Group 1 winner Champers Elysees and 6f 2yo winner Elzem; is by an emerging young sire and has a solid damline but made only Eur1,000 as a yearling; best watched for future reference.
runners.comment: Made only Eur1,000 as a yearling; best watched for future reference

runners.name: Orphanina
runners.spotlight: Was a big price when beaten 9l on debut at Naas; should have improved from that and could get closer in a weaker race today.
runners.comment: Beaten 9l on debut at Naas; should have improved and get closer in a weaker race today

runners.name: Whatsin The Stars
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two maidens and will be of more interest in handicaps.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two maidens and will be of more interest in handicaps

runners.name: Wooloongabba
runners.spotlight: Third runner for yard; well beaten in two maidens and will be of more interest in handicaps.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two maidens and will be of more interest in handicaps

runners.name: Brigerbad
runners.spotlight: Beaten 21l on debut over 6f at Cork and will have to improve hugely from that.
runners.comment: Beaten 21l on debut over 6f at Cork and will have to improve hugely from that

runners.name: Salamina
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in three maidens and will be of more interest in handicaps; yard second-string.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in three maidens and will be of more interest in handicaps

runners.name: Misneach Sile
runners.spotlight: Beaten 15l on debut at Naas over 1m and will have to improve lots to feature.
runners.comment: Beaten 15l on debut at Naas over 1m and will have to improve lots to feature

runners.name: Peshwari Nan
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; well beaten in two maidens and will be better off in handicaps.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two maidens and will be better off in handicaps

runners.name: Wellwhatshappenin
runners.spotlight: Had enjoyed a consistent spell at Dundalk; turf form is weak and well beaten behind Launch Time at Leopardstown; others preferred.
runners.comment: Turf form is weak and well beaten behind Launch Time at Leopardstown; others preferred

runners.name: Draiocht
runners.spotlight: Landed a 1m soft-ground handicap at Killarney in October; ran on well when less than a length off Launch Time over 7f at Leopardstown; better suited by 1m and is weighted to turn the tables.
runners.comment: Less than a length off Launch Time over 7f at Leopardstown; weighted to turn the tables

runners.name: La Campanella
runners.spotlight: Ran with credit in a couple of Fairyhouse handicaps and didn't quite get home over 1m1f at Gowran last time; dropping back to a sharp 1m looks well worthwhile.
runners.comment: Didn't quite get home over 1m1f at Gowran; drop back to a sharp 1m looks well worthwhile

runners.name: Launch Time
runners.spotlight: Won a pair of Leopardstown handicaps this year over 1m and 7f, the latter occasion in a first-time visor; didn't run badly off this mark at Cork last time; notable jockey booking and this represents a drop in class.
runners.comment: Dual Leopardstown winner; notable jockey booking and this represents a drop in class

runners.name: Hale Bopp
runners.spotlight: Last turf win in May 2022; been running well without threatening this year before two poor runs in June; now with his owner after almost three months off; best watched.
runners.comment: Two poor runs in June; now with his owner after almost three months off; best watched

runners.name: Distillate
runners.spotlight: Form tailed off at the end of a busy but winless winter; not seen since soundly beaten in a 6f handicap on heavy at Navan in March; best watched.
runners.comment: Not seen since soundly beaten in a 6f handicap on heavy at Navan in March; best watched

runners.name: Lohengrin
runners.spotlight: Showed little this year but, considering she lost two shoes in running, was not beaten far in a 1m1f handicap at Gowran two weeks ago; local stable always to be feared at this venue and market moves should be watched.
runners.comment: Local stable always to be feared at this venue and market moves should be watched

runners.name: Wegotogether
runners.spotlight: Some early maiden form reads well in the context of this race; kept on late on her reappearance over 6f at Navan in May; stable in very good form and this is a notable runner in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Off since May; stable in fine form and this is a notable runner in first-time cheekpieces

runners.name: Suerte
runners.spotlight: A 12-race maiden; bits and pieces of form to her credit and did some very good late work behind Launch Time at Leopardstown; okay draw for a hold-up filly and capable of getting involved.
runners.comment: Good run at Leopardstown; okay draw for a hold-up filly and capable of getting involved

runners.name: Rampage
runners.spotlight: Runner-up five times over C&D without winning; mostly out of form this year but down to a career low mark and perfectly possible that he could be revitalised here.
runners.comment: Down to a career low mark and perfectly possible that he could be revitalised here
runners.owner: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Syndicate/S Sweeney

runners.name: Tullyesker
runners.spotlight: Modest form in maidens last year; down the field on handicap/seasonal debut at Fairyhouse last month; new headgear tried here.
runners.comment: Down the field on handicap/seasonal debut at Fairyhouse last month; new headgear tried

runners.name: Jazz Dreamers
runners.spotlight: Is 3-34 on turf but no win in three years; okay run when fading into eighth at Leopardstown last month but couldn't build on that last time; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Eighth at Leopardstown last month but couldn't build on that last time; cheekpieces go on
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Butler & Mrs Bernadette Fahey & Seamus Fahey

runners.name: Bang Po
runners.spotlight: Sole win was on heavy ground in 2023; has struggled in recent seasons although ran okay in a 1m5f handicap at Navan in June; big drop back in trip here.
runners.comment: Ran okay in a 1m5f handicap at Navan in June; big drop back in trip here

runners.name: Pettus Bridge
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in maiden outings at 7f and 1m4f; hard to make a case for in his first handicap.
runners.comment: Has shown little in maiden outings at 7f and 1m4f; hard to make a case for

runners.name: Brains
runners.spotlight: Reserve; last of fourteen wins came in March last year; not beaten far last twice including behind Launch Time at Leopardstown; claims if getting a run.
runners.comment: Reserve; last of fourteen wins came in March last year; not beaten far last twice; claims

runners.name: Heart Of Eternity
runners.spotlight: Ex-Godolphin filly is down to a mark of 52 after being tried over various trips this term; not disgraced over 5f at the Curragh last week but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Not disgraced over 5f at the Curragh last week but others make more appeal

runners.name: Land Of The Giants
runners.spotlight: Disappointing overall; won a 1m1f handicap at Ayr in May; reasonable efforts in a couple of claimers since, including over C&D; likely to find a couple too good.
runners.comment: Reasonable efforts in a couple of claimers of late, including over C&D; others preferred

runners.name: Sunday Sovereign
runners.spotlight: No win since scoring for James McAuley in 2023; well beaten on his seasonal bow at Fairyhouse in June; probably wants it softer.
runners.comment: Well beaten on his seasonal bow at Fairyhouse in June; probably wants it softer

runners.name: Perfect Judgement
runners.spotlight: Dropped 12lb since joining Pat Murphy and ran by far his best race when second in a 1m1f handicap at Gowran two weeks ago; up 1lb for that but on a nice mark and one of the likelier ones to play a hand here.
runners.comment: Up 1lb for Gowran but on a nice mark and one of the likelier ones to play a hand here

runners.name: Micasso
runners.spotlight: Broke his duck in a C&D handicap early last month, but has made no impression in two runs since; respected back at this venue but not easy to know what to expect.
runners.comment: C&D winner last month; respected back at this venue but not easy to know what to expect

runners.name: Master Garvey
runners.spotlight: Last win in March last year; not easy to win with but often runs well in defeat; good third in a 1m1f handicap at Gowran last month; others look more solid overall.
runners.comment: Good third in a 1m1f handicap at Gowran last month; others look more solid overall
runners.owner: Patrick M O'Brien & Larry Murray & Derek Cummins

runners.name: Givehertilxmas
runners.spotlight: Narrowly beaten in a C&D handicap in October; excellent effort on her seasonal bow in a 7f handicap at Roscomon in June; Colin Keane rides here; cheekpieces tried and bad draw is the only real negative.
runners.comment: Colin Keane rides here; cheekpieces tried and the bad draw the only real negative

runners.name: Think About It
runners.spotlight: A 13-race maiden and not a huge amount to recommend; beaten a long way over 1m5f last time; champion jockey booked but needs to find a fair bit to get involved.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way over 1m5f last time; champion jockey booked but needs to find a fair bit

runners.name: Medieval Night
runners.spotlight: Busy summer but has coped well with it and his best effort when second to a subsequent winner over 1m1f at Gowran; drop back in trip not an obvious plus but looks a major contender just the same.
runners.comment: Drop back in trip not an obvious plus but looks a major contender just the same

runners.name: Duchess Anne
runners.spotlight: Bright start to the new campaign when fourth over 1m at Naas; made much of the running when second over 1m1f at Gowran last month; holds a definite chance.
runners.comment: Made much of the running when second over 1m1f at Gowran last month; has a definite chance

runners.name: Dinamine
runners.spotlight: Consistency paid off when getting up late after a slow start to win a Naas handicap last month; unlucky in running at Leopardstown next time before a poor run at the Curragh; good 7lb claimer on board.
runners.comment: Unlucky in running at Leopardstown next time before a poor run at the Curragh; claims

runners.name: Bright Dick
runners.spotlight: Dundalk winner in 2024; not seen since finishing a good third in a big-field 1m1f handicap at Leopardstown two years ago; best watched after such an absence.
runners.comment: Third in a big field 1m1f handicap at Leopardstown two years ago; best watched now

runners.name: Oitentinha
runners.spotlight: Modest form for Danny McLoughlin and no improvement in two runs for this yard; others preferred.
runners.comment: Modest form for Danny McLoughlin and no improvement in two runs for this yard

runners.name: Albion Power
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner has only had four starts on turf but didn't run badly at the Curragh in May; well beaten back at that venue the following month.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly at the Curragh in May; well beaten back at that venue the following month

runners.name: Chant d'Or
runners.spotlight: Three nondescript runs for two different yards; stable and handicap debut here but can't be fancied on what he has done to date.
runners.comment: Stable and handicap debut here but can't be fancied on what he has done to date

runners.name: Monzoon
runners.spotlight: Four career wins but poor form last year and has been off since December.
runners.comment: Four career wins but but poor form last year and has been off since December

races.race_name: Gleeson's Bar, Drogheda, Home Of Racing Handicap

runners.name: Dream Legend
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over C&D in April and added another win here when scooting clear last month; was raised 13lb for that but is so effective at this venue that he has to be given plenty of respect again for his local yard.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins; raised 13lb for latest but goes so well here has to be given respect
runners.owner: E D Delany & Mrs Lisa Delany

runners.name: Gloriously Glam
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; four-time turf winner has run well in defeat at this track, including when runner-up over C&D last month; poor at Galway last time and has to rebound.
runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D last month; poor at Galway last time and has to rebound; reserve

runners.name: Elusive Path
runners.spotlight: Steadily improved his RPRs in each maiden start between 7f and 1m, though did weaken late over the latter trip at Killarney last time; this easier mile can suit and is considered on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Weakened late over 1m at Killarney last time; this easier mile can suit and is considered

runners.name: Comfort Line
runners.spotlight: First reserve; won for the fourth time on turf when scoring over this trip at the Curragh last time; raised 3lb for that and has run well here before so considered.
runners.comment: Raised 3lb for Curragh win and has run well here before so considered; reserve

runners.name: Reponse Finale
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; has shown improved form for this yard lately, winning at Gowran (1m1.5f) and Dundalk (1m); is 12lb higher so will have to take another step forward.
runners.comment: Won at Gowran (1m1.5f) and Dundalk (1m) lately; up 12lb so will have to do more; reserve

runners.name: Anvika
runners.spotlight: Is just 1-25 on turf but has been placed lots of times; solid on last three starts including in a premier handicap at Leopardstown; capable of another decent showing.
runners.comment: Good run in a premier handicap at Leopardstown; capable of another decent showing

runners.name: Girl Bear
runners.spotlight: Showed promise on debut last year; hasn't had the best of runs in last two handicaps at Fairyhouse (6f) and Galway (7f); the step up in trip might suit and can't be dismissed even from a difficult draw.
runners.comment: Not the best of runs last twice; step up in trip might suit and can't be dismissed

runners.name: Goal Exceeded
runners.spotlight: Won for the third time when taking a 7f Leopardstown handicap in June; two solid efforts in defeat off higher marks since; looks the stable's first-string and has a good draw so one to consider.
runners.comment: Solid in defeat last twice; looks stable's first-string; has a good draw so considered
runners.owner: B White & M W White & Ms H McGuinness & D Sheridan

runners.name: Zaraahmando
runners.spotlight: Won three times last year up to 1m and in varying ground conditions; solid efforts in defeat on last four starts, including at Galway last time; should be involved but high draw is a negative.
runners.comment: Solid in defeat on last four starts, incl' at Galway; be involved but draw is a negative

runners.name: Pillar Of Hope
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner up to 1m4f; his best run this year came over the latter trip at Galway last time but he might find this trip on the sharp side.
runners.comment: Good run over 1m4f at Galway last time but he might find this trip on the sharp side

runners.name: Bundle Of Interest
runners.spotlight: Sole win came over 6f at Navan last year; the best of three runs this year came over 1m at the Curragh last time when weakened late on; this is slightly shorter on an easier track so can run well but draw is a negative.
runners.comment: Weakened late on over 1m at Curragh last time; this is slightly shorter on an easier track

runners.name: Rappell
runners.spotlight: Has won four times on turf up to 6.5f; was disappointing at Naas last time over 7f and others make more appeal over this trip.
runners.comment: Disappointing at Naas last time over 7f and others make more appeal over this trip

runners.name: Felix Somary
runners.spotlight: A 2yo debut winner last year is yet to add to that success but posted solid efforts the last twice, at Navan (1m2f) and Galway over an extended mile; prominent racer should be suited by this track and the visor worn last time is retained; a player.
runners.comment: Prominent racer should be suited by this track and the visor worn last time is retained

runners.name: Morehampton
runners.spotlight: Hasn't added to his Gowran 2yo maiden win since but some fine efforts including a third back at that track over 7f last time; up 2lb and should stay this trip so can go well.
runners.comment: Third at Gowran over 7f last time; up 2lb and should stay this trip so can go well

runners.name: Glyndwr
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner for Ger Lyons; has been running with credit in defeat lately for this yard on turf up to 1m1f; should run another sound race but stall 18 is no help.
runners.comment: Been running with credit in defeat lately; should do so again but stall 18 is no help

runners.name: Slight Of Foot
runners.spotlight: Didn't progress when trained in UK last year; the best of his three runs for this yard came in a Gowran claimer last time; this is tougher so needs more; the hood worn then is left off.
runners.comment: Third in a Gowran claimer last time over this trip; this is tougher so needs more

runners.name: Goofy Gander
runners.spotlight: Promise on 2yo debut last year but hasn't really built on that; raced a bit keenly before weakening over this trip at Limerick last time but still a decent effort; could have more to offer so considered, especially if strong in the market.
runners.comment: Not a bad run at Limerick last time; could have more to offer so considered

runners.name: Exquisite Acclaim
runners.spotlight: One of three runners for yard; eight wins on AW but is just 1-35 on turf; some decent efforts in defeat this season but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Some decent efforts in defeat this season but others make more appeal
runners.owner: Thomas J O'Connor & Ms Hazel McGuinness

runners.name: Bit Of A Buzz
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who has been in the frame on all six runs, five of them over this trip; the best effort was third over C&D last month; yard in form; has to be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Consistent sort; the best of six runs was third over C&D last month; on the shortlist

runners.name: Annie Batt
runners.spotlight: Just denied on debut over C&D last month (winner now rated 97); had an excuse for a poor Navan run 9 days later (blowing hard post-race); has been freshened up since and has a major shout if back to that debut form.
runners.comment: Just denied on debut over C&D but had an excuse for a poor Navan run 9 days later; a shout

runners.name: Tango Club
runners.spotlight: Decent efforts in maidens at Cork (5f) and Sligo (6f); weakened over the latter trip last time after racing keenly so the drop back to 5f should suit; can be involved.
runners.comment: Decent efforts at Cork (5f) and Sligo (6f); weakened over latter trip so back to 5f suits

runners.name: Belle Island
runners.spotlight: Two good AW runs to start her career but has gone backwards on turf since; tongue-tie is added in an attempt to get her back on track.
runners.comment: Two good AW runs but has gone backwards on turf; tongue-tie added
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell

runners.name: Best Love
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut at the Curragh over 6f; similar runs in defeat in 5f Cork maidens last twice; needs to find a bit more.
runners.comment: Similar runs in defeat in 5f Cork maidens last twice; needs to find a bit more

runners.name: Lion Of Fortune
runners.spotlight: From the family of French 1000 Guineas winner Flotilla but failed to sell cheaply as a yearling; beaten 8l on debut at Curragh; entitled to improve and could get more involved.
runners.comment: Beaten 8l on debut at Curragh; entitled to improve and could get more involved

runners.name: Magna Fortuna
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two maidens over further and handicaps will suit better in time; hood added.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two maidens and handicaps will suit better in time

runners.name: Sadie Rose
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in Dundalk and Naas maidens so is one for nurseries in time.
runners.comment: Well beaten in Dundalk and Naas maidens so is one for nurseries in time

runners.name: Bad Boy Rizz
runners.spotlight: Navan maiden winner last season has been solid in defeat on all four starts this term; wasn't at his best over 6f at Naas last time but is slowly coming down the weights so considered.
runners.comment: Solid runs all four starts this term; slowly coming down the weights so considered

runners.name: Asdana
runners.spotlight: Is just 1-17 but her best run this term came over C&D, albeit that was on soft ground; has a chance if returning to that form, though this is livelier ground.
runners.comment: Is just 1-17 but her best run this term came over C&D; a chance if returning to that form

runners.name: Namiid
runners.spotlight: Navan maiden winner in May over this trip has been consistent in defeat in handicaps since; runner-up over C&D last month and a close third at Curragh since; likely to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Navan maiden winner has been consistent in h'caps since and likely to be on the premises

runners.name: Prairie Girl
runners.spotlight: Improved last winter AW season, winining three times over this trip before disappointing over 6f on final start; a cracking run at Curragh on return last time after 170 days away; should go close now off the same mark.
runners.comment: Three AW wins; cracking run at Curragh on return last time; go close off the same mark
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Smoke Them Out
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been at 6f, though has run well at this trip and 7f; ran well in defeat over C&D last month but was poor last time at Naas so has to bounce back; seems best with more ease.
runners.comment: Three wins have been at 6f; ran well in defeat over C&D last month; poor last time

runners.name: Happy Henry
runners.spotlight: Took time to break his duck but won twice this year including over C&D; however, was well beaten by Harry's Hill at Curragh last time so has work to do today.
runners.comment: Won twice this year including over C&D; well beaten by Harry's Hill at Curragh last time

runners.name: Bye Bye Now
runners.spotlight: AW winner in March was second to Happy Henry over C&D last month but posted a lesser run since at Down Royal and has to find more.
runners.comment: AW winner was 2nd to Happy Henry over C&D last month but a lesser run since

runners.name: Treasured Royal
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f Navan maiden last year; some decent efforts in defeat this season but was disappointing over 6f at the Curragh three days ago; would have a squeak on her better earlier runs including here.
runners.comment: Disappointing over 6f three days ago but would have a squeak on her better earlier runs

runners.name: Buddy Batt
runners.spotlight: C&D winner at 2; has notched three AW wins since, the latest in March; however, he has to improve loads on his recent turf runs.
runners.comment: C&D winner at 2; three AW wins since; has to improve loads on recent turf runs

runners.name: Harry's Hill
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner, including this race in 2024; won his 10th race (all over this trip) when scoring at the Curragh last time; has to be respected up 4lb.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner won his 10th race when scoring at Curragh last time; respected up 4lb

runners.name: Cuban Grey
runners.spotlight: A seven-time winner who has run well in defeat here; has been consistent lately, though 6f at Dundalk last time probably stretched him; needs a bit more to score off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Has run well in defeat here; has been consistent lately but needs a bit more

runners.name: Cosmetic
runners.spotlight: Has improved from two to three, but not enough to have won a race yet; disappointing at Galway (behind Shemiyka) but a good second over this trip at Fairyhouse previously and would go very close on that running.
runners.comment: Disappointing at Galway but a good second over this trip at Fairyhouse previously; claims
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Zadawa
runners.spotlight: Three decent runs in maidens and gradually improving; indicated at Cork last time that a step up in trip might suit; could be the one here.
runners.comment: Indicated at Cork last time that a step up in trip might suit; could be the one here
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Pampar Lady
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick over hurdles this time last year and rated 118 in that sphere; remote second in a Ballinrobe maiden last month; mid-division in a better Galway contest since.
runners.comment: Remote second in a Ballinrobe maiden last month; mid-division in a better Galway contest

runners.name: Mawhibah
runners.spotlight: Steady improvement in three runs; beaten favourite at Tramore last time and this looks tougher; should run well though.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite at Tramore last time and this looks tougher; should run well though
runners.owner: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah

runners.name: Shemiyka
runners.spotlight: Totally outran her 100-1 odds in a first-time visor on her stable debut at Galway (Cosmetic and Ocean Fire behind); drop back in trip at Sligo probably did not suit and has to be taken seriously back up in trip here.
runners.comment: Drop back in trip at Sligo did not suit and has to be taken seriously back up in trip here

runners.name: Helen's Blaze
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 8.4f/1m4f Flat (RPR 97) and useful 2m hurdle winner, half-sister to 1m winner Wild China, out of once-raced half-sister to winners Via Archimede (1m4f) and Glasog (5f 2yo); best watched on her somewhat belated debut.
runners.comment: Best watched on her somewhat belated debut
runners.owner: Karl Davis & Seamus Domegan & Mrs Bridget Dillon

runners.name: Kigalienne
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; sister to 1m4f winner Kingstonian (RPR 100), half-sister to five winners inc Tidal Storm (1m4f AW; RPR 75), Kinaesthesia (1m 2yo; 72) and Cheng Gong (11.4f-1m4f Flat inc AW, 67; 2m3f hurdle); dam 7f 2yo winner (inc Listed; 98); home-bred filly from a good middle-distance family; no surprise if she went close.
runners.comment: Home-bred filly from a good middle-distance family; no surprise if she went close

runners.name: Ocean Fire
runners.spotlight: Decent run at Galway last time when Shemiyka and Cosmetic were in front of her; needs this for a mark but might well sneak into a place.
runners.comment: Shemiyka and Cosmetic were just in front of her at Galway; needs this for a mark

runners.name: Fraher Field
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner and runner-up in a couple of maiden hurdles; soundly beaten in a couple of Flat maidens though and this is tougher again.
runners.comment: Bumper winner; soundly beaten in a couple of Flat maidens though and this is tougher again
runners.owner: John J Flynn, Pierce Flynn, Conor Lannen

runners.name: Ventriloquist
runners.spotlight: Beat one home in a 1m2f Leopardstown maiden in June; hard to assess but others look much more likely.
runners.comment: Beat one home in a 1m2f Leopardstown maiden in June; others look much more likely

runners.name: Nugentstown Sue
runners.spotlight: Little to recommend in mostly bumper and maiden hurdle company.
runners.comment: Little to recommed in mostly bumper and maiden hurdle company

runners.name: Boxing Great
runners.spotlight: Won nicely over 2m at Dundalk in December and showed he could do it on turf when scoring over 1m7f at Leopardstown last time; only 1lb higher here and looks to have a leading chance.
runners.comment: Only 1lb higher here for his Leopardstown win and looks to have a leading chance

runners.name: Catalani
runners.spotlight: Three time point winner and winning chaser; reverted to the Flat of late and only beaten a half-length by Boxing Great at Leopardstown; should not be far away.
runners.comment: Only beaten a half-length by Boxing Great at Leopardstown; should not be far away

runners.name: Day Trader
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner and came right back to form when a staying-on second in a 1m4f handicap at Galway; up 3lb for that but probably not on a bad mark and the trip should not be an issue.
runners.comment: Up 3lb for Galway but probably not on a bad mark and the trip should not be an issue

runners.name: Friary Road
runners.spotlight: Looks to be appreciating his reversion to the Flat, especially when runner-up in a 1m7f handicap at Leopardstown last month; certainly of interest here.
runners.comment: Runner-up in a 1m7f handicap at Leopardstown last month; certainly of interest here

runners.name: Cooley's Mist
runners.spotlight: Consistent since joining Harry Rogers; deserved success at Leopardstown last month and ran equally well when runner-up over the same C&D last week; untried over the trip but probably the one to beat if he stays.
runners.comment: Wiinner and second at Leopardstown; untried over the trip but the one to beat if he stays

runners.name: Liberated Light
runners.spotlight: Switched to the Flat of late and not disgraced over 2m at Tramore and 1m4f at Gowran; more needed here though.
runners.comment: Switched to the Flat of late and not disgraceed over 2m at Tramore and 1m4f at Gowran

runners.name: Miss Gitana
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form with a close third under a positive ride at Leopardstown (1m7f) last month; similar level when runner-up over 1m4f at Tramore since; solid claims.
runners.comment: Solid efforts in defeat at Leopardstown and Tramore; solid claims here

runners.name: Kimy
runners.spotlight: Not the most consistent of conveyances; good effort when second in a 1m4f Tramore maiden last month; well beaten twice since.
runners.comment: Good effort when second in a 1m4f Tramore maiden last month; well beaten twice since

runners.name: Sequoiaspirit
runners.spotlight: Decisive winner of a Roscommon handicap hurdle in June; underwhelming effort at Galway since then; four-time winner on the Flat, most recently off 67 in 2023; interesting runner.
runners.comment: Four-time winner on the Flat, most recently off 67 in 2023; interesting runner

runners.name: Jerandme
runners.spotlight: Eight career wins for this veteran but definitely a light of other days; mid-divison in a Clonmel claiming hurdle in May; others more likely.
runners.comment: Light of other days; mid-divison in a Clonmel claiming hurdle in May; others more likely

runners.name: Baltic Bird
runners.spotlight: Won a Flat maiden at York in 2022 for the Gosdens; winner over hurdles and fences since; in and out over fences this season; classy performer at his best but out of form coming in here.
runners.comment: In and out over fences this season; classy performer at his best but out of form coming in

races.race_name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week 2026 Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Letmeseethecolts
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over 1m3f and 1m4f on the Flat; has made a promising start over hurdles, latest when third of 13 at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last month; should be suited by this step up in trip and run well.
runners.comment: Has made a promising start over hurdles, latest when third at Uttoxeter last month.

runners.name: Diamond Grace
runners.spotlight: Has ran well to be placed in her two starts over hurdles this summer, latest when runner-up at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last month; she should progress with racing and looks sure to be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Has ran well to be placed in her two starts over hurdles this summer.

runners.name: Guts And Glory
runners.spotlight: Fell in her only point, but finished second in her first two runs over hurdles; below that form when fifth of seven at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) in April; wears first-time tongue-tie and needs to get back to her best.
runners.comment: Fell in her only point, but finished second in her first two runs over hurdles.

runners.name: Pretty Spontaneous
runners.spotlight: More letters than numbers in her form in points this year; sports first-time tongue-tie for good yard on hurdles debut and interesting if she can show improvement.
runners.comment: More letters than numbers in her form in points this year.

runners.name: Dreaming Of The Dr
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in all three bumpers; deemed a non-runner on her intended hurdling debut at Worcester last Wednesday after facing the wrong way when the flag fell; should have a future in this sphere.
runners.comment: Has shown ability in all three bumpers.

runners.name: La Bamba Chica
runners.spotlight: Last of five on her bumper debut at Exeter (2m1f, good) in April; that will have blown away the cobwebs and worth a check in the market on this hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Last of five on her bumper debut at Exeter in April.

runners.name: Princess Of Ballea
runners.spotlight: Beaten 15l and 51l on her two completed starts over hurdles and needs to show significant improvement.
runners.comment: Beaten 15l and 51l on her two completed starts over hurdles.

runners.name: Steal A Glance
runners.spotlight: Best of three runs over hurdles when fifth of eight at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good to firm) last month; needs to step up again here; stable also runs Pretty Spontaneous.
runners.comment: Best of three runs over hurdles when fifth at Newton Abbot last month.

runners.name: Brionywells
runners.spotlight: Showed improvement on her return when getting off the mark at Worcester (2m7f, good) in May, and followed up at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) a week later; didn't fare too badly off 7lb higher when fourth of seven finishers at Market Rasen (2m7f, good) subsequently and may be worth another chance.
runners.comment: Landed a double at Worcester and Uttoxeter this summer; fourth at Market Rasen since.

runners.name: Kotgar
runners.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles but has shown bits of form when in the frame; doesn't look the most straightforward and goes without headgear worn on last two runs; steps up in trip but beginning to look exposed.
runners.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but has shown bits of form when in the frame.

runners.name: Bells Of Ufford
runners.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles but has finished second on two occasions; swaps cheekpieces for a first-time visor and steps up in trip; down to a career-low mark but vulnerable to improvers.
runners.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but has finished second on two occasions.

runners.name: Delgany Second Now
runners.spotlight: Has cut little ice so far but steps up in trip on handicap debut for champion trainer and looks sure to find improvement; market will be best guide.
runners.comment: Has cut little ice so far but steps up in trip on handicap debut for champion trainer.

runners.name: French Diablo
runners.spotlight: Has improved since stepping up in trip in handicaps, finishing third over C&D (good to firm) in June before getting off the mark over C&D (good to firm) last month; goes without the hood worn on last three starts; should be able to deal with the 4lb rise.
runners.comment: Finished third over C&D in June before getting off the mark over C&D last month.

runners.name: Captain Connor
runners.spotlight: Has shown just modest form so far over hurdles; steps up in trip on stable debut and needs to find improvement.
runners.comment: Has shown just modest form so far over hurdles; steps up in trip on stable debut.

runners.name: Mc'flo
runners.spotlight: 0-12 and showing little signs that a win is imminent; her mark continues to slide and hard to fancy.
runners.comment: 0-12 and showing little signs that a win is imminent.

runners.name: Pink Walls
runners.spotlight: Has yet to get competitive in five runs over hurdles; hood worn on last two runs is left off and doesn't appeal.
runners.comment: Has yet to get competitive in five runs over hurdles.

runners.name: Beorma
runners.spotlight: Has proved to be a revelation since being fitted with a tongue-tie, winning her last seven races and remains unbeaten in four runs over fences; there is not knowing when this winning streak will come to an end but she still looks to be ahead of the handicapper and the one to beat once more.
runners.comment: Has been a revelation since being fitted with a tongue-tie, winning her last seven races.

runners.name: Seeyouinmydreams
runners.spotlight: Won five times over hurdles for Paul Nicholls; well held in two runs over fences for current yard this summer; goes without customary hood and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Well held in two runs over fences for current yard this summer.

runners.name: Duke Of Luckley
runners.spotlight: Gained his sixth win over fences, at Southwell (2m, good) when making all in June off 8lb lower; looked to be found out by the weight rise when third of four at Newton Abbot (2m, good) last month, and although this track may play to his strengths he has never won off such a high mark; first-time blinkers replace visor.
runners.comment: Gained his sixth win over fences, at Southwell when making all in June off 8lb lower.

runners.name: In This World
runners.spotlight: Sole success over fences when trained by Dan Skelton over two years ago; plenty of water under the bridge since but was still in with a chance when falling at the last fence over C&D (good to firm) in May; looks the obvious alternative should the favourite slip up.
runners.comment: Still in with a chance when falling at the last fence over C&D in May.

runners.name: Juggernaut
runners.spotlight: Second of two wins over hurdles came over C&D in October 2024; has been a beaten favourite eight times since and not one to have maximum faith with.
runners.comment: Second of two wins over hurdles came over C&D in October 2024.

runners.name: Getmyfriend
runners.spotlight: Landed a bumper at Southwell (2m, good) in May and got off the mark on her second run over hurdles at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good to firm) last month; can be expected to find more improvement on her handicap debut and will be hard to beat.
runners.comment: Got off the mark on her second run over hurdles at Newton Abbot last month.

runners.name: Mi Sueno
runners.spotlight: Won twice for Paddy Butler in the spring of 2024 on soft; made an immediate impact when scoring for the first time since at Newton Abbot (2m3f, good to firm) last month on stable debut in returning cheekpieces (retained since); not disgraced when runner-up back there on Saturday and remains in decent form; claims.
runners.comment: Scored for the first time since 2024 at Newton Abbot last month on stable debut.

runners.name: T Or Coffey
runners.spotlight: Formerly trained in Ireland, he made an instant impact when landing a maiden hurdle here (2m, good to firm) last July; ran three times on the Flat in the autumn without success; first run since when sixth of seven at Worcester (2m, good; 25-1) last month and looks to need to come down the weights.
runners.comment: Sixth at Worcester last month and looks to need to come down the weights.

runners.name: Dream Jet
runners.spotlight: Has been out of form over fences and reverts back to hurdles for the first time since October 2023; hard to be confident about his chance here.
runners.comment: Out of form over fences and reverts back to hurdles for the first time since October 2023.

runners.name: Zucayan
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been at Ludlow over 2m and it may pay to wait until he returns to his favoured track.
runners.comment: All three wins have been at Ludlow over 2m and it may pay to wait until he returns there.

runners.name: Miss Fedora
runners.spotlight: Gained last two wins over fences; not in the best of form since joining this yard in the spring and stable's other runner, Mi Sueno, looks to hold a better chance.
runners.comment: Gained last two wins over fences; not in the best of form since joining this yard.

runners.name: Borna Gem
