runners.spotlight: Made shaky start to hurdling career during the winter but benefited from combination of drop in trip and switch to good ground when winning 2m Ludlow maiden by 4l in March; below that form when last of nine finishers here (2m, good) the following month on handicap debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Below form when last of nine finishers here in April on handicap debut.

races.race_name: Thank You To Our Hardworking Groundstaff Handicap Chase

runners.name: Crackerjack Queen
runners.spotlight: Runner-up off this mark at Southwell (2m4f, good) in June and she's of interest on that form but she's been well beaten on both starts since and a major turnaround is needed in a change of headgear.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Southwell in June but well beaten on both starts since; headgear change

runners.name: Youdecide
runners.spotlight: Pulled up when favourite at Wetherby in March and absent since; however, this point and handicap hurdle winner is only six and may have benefited from the break; could have a part to play on his return to action.
runners.comment: Pulled up in March and absent since but only six and may have benefited from the break

runners.name: Jack Doyen
runners.spotlight: Made it three wins from his last four starts when scoring at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in May; this 10yo is returning from a 98-day break today but holds strong claims if resuming where he left off.
runners.comment: Three wins in the spring and holds strong claims if resuming where he left off

runners.name: Bobbarelli
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 9yo who flopped over hurdles in June but has had a break since and was a good second over fences here (2m1f, good to firm) in May; ran well in 2m5f novice hurdle in March and should be fine back up in trip; could bounce back with a bold bid under regular rider Amber Jackson-Fennell.
runners.comment: Flopped over hurdles in June but good 2nd over fences here previously; could bounce back

runners.name: Pescatorius
runners.spotlight: Won last autumn on final two runs for Olly Murphy (3m2f/2m5f, good to firm/good to soft) and he took a step back in the right direction when third of six at Warwick (3m, good) in June when last seen; runs off his last winning mark and he might not be far away.
runners.comment: Step back in right direction when 3rd at Warwick last time and runs off last winning mark

runners.name: Watchoutitscookie
runners.spotlight: 8yo who has a poor strike-rate and is 4lb out of the handicap this evening; however, he ran pretty well when 10l third of eight at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good to firm) last month and is not ruled out.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but ran well when third at Newton Abbot last month and he's not ruled out

runners.name: Fox Wallace
runners.spotlight: Won here in May 2025 but that's been her sole victory and she hasn't been shaping this season as though another is imminent.
runners.comment: Won here in May 2025 but hasn't been shaping as though a second victory is imminent
runners.owner: M Enticott / Ella Pickard Racing Club

runners.name: Kings Order
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up who is only five and it's still very early days over fences; however, he's been soundly beaten on both outings in this sphere and needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: Only five but well beaten on both starts over fences and needs to raise his game

races.race_name: Hollow Bottom National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (Conditional & Amateur Jockeys) (GBB)

runners.name: Roccana Rose
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to Honeysuckle; met traffic issues en route to promising fourth of eight, beaten over 2l, at Newton Abbot in early June; the form choice on her return from 83-day absence.
runners.comment: Related to Honeysuckle; promising fourth at Newton Abbot in early June; the form pick

runners.name: Talladale
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability with fifth of 11 in Uttoxeter contest and had a few of today's rivals behind him; open to progress with that experience under his belt; one of the main contenders.
runners.comment: Showed some ability with fifth of 11 at Uttoxeter; one of the main contenders

runners.name: Guerdale
runners.spotlight: Far from solid on her two efforts and is again best watched.
runners.comment: Far from solid on her two efforts

runners.name: Company Charge
runners.spotlight: Has a useful pedigree; seemed to need the outing/experience at Newton Abbot, finishing fifth of nine; open to improvement, assuming he takes to the application of headgear.
runners.comment: Seemed to need the outing at Newton Abbot; open to improvement; headgear fitted

runners.name: Goliath Power
runners.spotlight: First foal of French 2m2f hurdle/2m3f chase winner, from family of four-time World Hurdle winner Big Buck's; one of two newcomers in the field; market instructive.
runners.comment: From the family of Big Buck's; one of two newcomers in the field; market informative

runners.name: Bombus Pascuorum
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Absolutely Buzzing (1m AW; RPR 69) and Seven Ravens (Japanese 7f dirt), out of 1m2f scorer (76); check the betting.
runners.comment: Flat-bred debutant; check the betting

runners.name: Pearl Cove
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced filly who has poor claims on form.
runners.comment: Poor claims on form

runners.name: Stand Proud
runners.spotlight: Had wind surgery prior to Uttoxeter yet still made a respiratory noise (finished down the field); bred to do better, being related to several winners (including in bumpers) for his yard.
runners.comment: Made a respiratory noise at Uttoxeter; related to winners for his yard; may improve

runners.name: On The Fly
runners.spotlight: Eventually dropped right away, having made the running, in Uttoxeter event; needs to step up markedly on that form.
runners.comment: Eventually dropped right away in Uttoxeter event
